<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_VacationRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewRejectionReasons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_ReviewRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApproveOrReject_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyHR</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_CompleteManagementProcedures</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestProcessed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmittedToRegister</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmittedToRegister</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ReviewRequest" name="Review vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApproveOrReject_Split" name="Approve or reject?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnApplication" name="Return application to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToReviewRejection</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToReviewRejection</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewRejectionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewRejectionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyHR" name="Generate notification to HR representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyToProcedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_CompleteManagementProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyToProcedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProceduresToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestProcessed" name="Vacation request processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProceduresToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmittedToRegister" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToReview" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="UserTask_ReviewRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDecision" sourceRef="UserTask_ReviewRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ApproveOrReject_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_ApproveOrReject_Split" targetRef="Task_ReturnApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApproveOrReject_Split" targetRef="Task_NotifyHR"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToReviewRejection" sourceRef="Task_ReturnApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewRejectionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToProcedures" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHR" targetRef="UserTask_CompleteManagementProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProceduresToEnd" sourceRef="UserTask_CompleteManagementProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestProcessed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
